posts.title: Classic Creamy Cucumber and Onion Salad That Brightens Any Meal
posts.description: This salad is a refreshing mix of crisp cucumbers and sharp onions tossed in a tangy vinegar and creamy sour cream dressing. It's perfect for summer dinners or potlucks when you want something cool and light.
